name: Agents Are Warm Coral Mascots, Never Machines
summary: AI agents render as the locked coral holographic mascots that cast light, not as robots, drones, androids, HUDs, or armor.
rules: The agentic workforce is depicted by the locked mascot entities: sub-agent (white sailor cap) and Chief of Agents (gold admiral hat), small blocky translucent coral beings that CAST LIGHT AND NOT SHADOW. The supercharged-laptop glows whole as one translucent object in the color of the agent supercharging it, with its screen face visible to the viewer (the agent lives on that screen). The rejected poles are law: no neon, no HUD or arc-reactor vocabulary, no 3D/CGI/Pixar plastic. A composition about agents shows a calm human as the source and the small helpers carrying the hours outward, never a person dwarfed by machinery.
origin: The locked sub-agent / chief-of-agents / supercharged-laptop invariants; the person-as-source aim discipline across nobody-labeled-the-door and the-introducer.
